name: Conversational Etiquette
description: The teaching plan includes introducing Grice’s maxims. It suggests starting with examples of effective and poor conversations from texts or videos, followed by group analysis. This leads into an explanation of Grice’s maxims, and concludes with a class discussion on real-life conversational habits and potential improvements.
